Israel, return to Yahweh your God; for you have fallen because of your sin.
“The virgin of Israel has fallen; She shall rise no more. She is cast down on her land; there is no one to raise her…
Don’t rejoice against me, my enemy. When I fall, I will arise. When I sit in darkness, Yahweh will be a light to me.
“They say, ‘If a man puts away his wife, and she goes from him, and becomes another man’s, should he return to her…

The pride of Israel testifies to his face; yet they haven’t returned to Yahweh their God, nor sought him, for all this.

translations.web: “Moreover you shall tell them, ‘Yahweh says: “ ‘Do men fall, and not rise up again? Does one turn away, and not return?
translations.bsb: So you are to tell them this is what the LORD says: “Do men fall and not get up again? Does one turn away and not return?
translations.kjv: Moreover thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the LORD; Shall they fall, and not arise? shall he turn away, and not return?
translations.asv: Moreover thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith Jehovah: Shall men fall, and not rise up again? Shall one turn away, and not return?
